pricing_disclaimer.name: Bozzuto Total Monthly Leasing Price Disclaimer [STANDARD]
pricing_disclaimer.label: Bozzuto Total Monthly Leasing Price Disclaimer
pricing_disclaimer.short_description: *Prices include base rent, all required monthly fees and any user-selected optional fees. Variable or usage-based fees are not included.
pricing_disclaimer.long_description: *Prices include base rent, all required monthly fees and any user-selected optional fees. Base Rent shown is the lowest possible rental price for the selected apartment home. Lease terms and available options are subject to change and may vary based on apartment home availability and any applicable program requirements. Move-In Date and Lease Term affect your monthly cost. To see lease term pricing based on move-in dates, click the 'Apply' button to be taken to our application portal. Variable or usage-based fees are not calculated in totals. Additional fees may apply in specific situations as detailed in the application and/or lease agreement. Some fees may not apply to apartment homes subject to an affordable program. Some apartment homes may require prequalification if required by any applicable affordability program. All pricing and fees are subject to the terms of the application and/or lease.

data.calculator_disclaimer: *Prices include Base Rent, all required monthly fees, and any user-selected optional fees. Base Rent shown is the lowest possible rental price for the selected apartment home. Lease terms and available options are subject to change and may vary based on apartment home availability and applicable program requirements. Monthly cost varies based on Move-In Date and Lease Term. To view lease term pricing by move-in date, select "Apply" to access the application portal. Rentable items are subject to availability. Variable or usage-based fees are not included in totals. Additional fees may apply as outlined in the application and/or lease agreement. Some fees may not apply to apartment homes subject to an affordable program. Some apartment homes may require prequalification based on affordable program requirements. All pricing and fees are subject to the terms of the application and/or lease. This calculation is prorated based on your move-in date. Leases beginning in the second half of the month may also require the following month's full rent to be paid at move-in. Contact the Leasing Team for more details.
